title: ID0435495-DC/Si-D/DE- [ MP / S8 170003981] EC card terminal is not responding
description:
Reported issue:  The EC card terminal is not responding. Please provide a permanent solution. Restarting the charging station now. Customers keep leaving without being able to charge. Please provide a solution to this problem. Restarting it repeatedly is not an option. Customers keep leaving without being able to charge.
Workaround: Reboot charger

additional_info.body:
Hi Michael, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
Thank you for reporting the error again.
For your information, we have been reporting this problem since the beginning when you first reported. We have escalated this topic to our R&D team and we are waiting for their reply, which we expect to be a hotfix or a bug fix.
They are aware of this issue and they are currently debating on how to proceed with this problem.
I understand your frustration since you rely a lot on Credit Card payments, but please be aware that we are really trying our best to push this hotfix as fast as possible.
Since the error was cleared, I will close the ticket. As always please reporting so that we can help as fast as possible.
Thank you for your patience and support so far. I wish you a nice weekend.
Best regards,
Francisco
